title: MW-C: extend the canonical-owner guard that #253 landed to copies of registered bodies anywhere in the tree, pin undecided candidates exactly, and guard historical entries
problem: Unit MW-C asks for a function-to-canonical-module registry whose test fails when a new module re-implements a registered function (asks S52.A1, S69.A3, S76.A2; units WU-03, WU-09, WU-12, WU-13 and MU-H wait on it). #253 (f6f003b2) landed the registry and guard 3, but an adversarial study on the line at 12119590 reproduced that guard 3 misses a copy written as a method, a copy outside its six packages, a copy with renamed locals or changed literals, and a copy inside the owner's own directory; that a competing owner can enter an undecided record as a candidate or a distinct entry with every guard green; that nothing stops an implementation kept only for history; and that the registry's REALITY reason ('read by nothing') is false.
founder_intent_refs: INTENT-20261113-ONE-ENTRANCE (take the first unclaimed buildable unit afterwards)
baseline: On the line at 12119590: docs/collaboration/ARCHITECTURE-OWNERSHIP-MAP.yaml function_owner_records holds 8 records (5 CANONICAL, 3 NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION); tests/unit/test_canonical_owner_guard.py has 16 tests, including guard 3 (exact AST, module level, six packages) and a removal-only pin; scripts/ci/check_canonical_owner_guard_mutants.py runs 59 mutants in CI job 10b; tests/unit/test_no_structural_duplicates.py compares names-erased bodies over the whole tree but keeps constants and is not linked to the registry. S52.A1 and S69.A3 read UNIT_VERIFIED (partial); S76.A2 reads INTENDED (gap) and cites nothing.

pass_2.final_design: Guard 4 compares every canonical, candidate and alternate body of function_owner_records, erased of names and constants from a fresh copy and of at least 25 AST nodes, with every function and method at any depth in every runtime file listed from the filesystem (full-prefix skips only); a match outside the record's modules fails. A distinct entry never exempts and may not name a module holding a copy. Undecided records' candidates are pinned exactly. HISTORICAL or RETIRED alternates still in the tree need kept_for naming a reading consumer outside greg/ and tests/ or an open decision. REALITY's reason is corrected. S69.A3 and S76.A2 cite the new tests and stay partial; S52.A1 names the anchor question.
